phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Mosin M91/30 PU Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 7.62×54mmR primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 390 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 390 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 730 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 865 m/s (3600 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Manual Bolt Cycle & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 5-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the Mosin M91/30 PU staged for its 15 RPM (Manual Turned-Down Bolt) cadence.

zh.headline: 莫辛-纳甘 M91/30 PU 栓动狙击步枪：1891 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 莫辛-纳甘 M91/30 PU 狙击型从常规步枪中甄选最高精度枪管，加装加长下弯拉机柄与紧凑型 3.5 倍 PU 侧装瞄准镜；其独创的弹仓阻铁（Interrupter）彻底杜绝了 7.62×54mmR 凸缘弹卡壳，在二战东线成就传奇狙击战绩。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Mosin M91/30 PU 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1891 年问世的 莫辛-纳甘 M91/30 PU 栓动狙击步枪 由俄国 / 苏联图拉与伊热夫斯克兵工厂主导研制，定位为经典的经典旋转后拉栓动狙击步枪。莫辛-纳甘系列自 1891 年定型以来总产量逾 3,700 万支；二战期间斯大林格勒狙击手瓦西里·扎伊采夫与柳德米拉·帕夫利琴科均以 M91/30 狙击步枪闻名于世。
莫辛-纳甘 M91/30 PU 狙击型从常规步枪中甄选最高精度枪管，加装加长下弯拉机柄与紧凑型 3.5 倍 PU 侧装瞄准镜；其独创的弹仓阻铁（Interrupter）彻底杜绝了 7.62×54mmR 凸缘弹卡壳，在二战东线成就传奇狙击战绩。 整件装备总长 1,232 mm（全长木托）、空重 4.27 kg，成为同期狙击步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1891 年，俄国 / 苏联图拉与伊热夫斯克兵工厂推出了划时代的莫辛-纳甘 M91/30 PU 栓动狙击步枪。莫辛-纳甘系列自 1891 年定型以来总产量逾 3,700 万支；二战期间斯大林格勒狙击手瓦西里·扎伊采夫与柳德米拉·帕夫利琴科均以 M91/30 狙击步枪闻名于世。 它的核心设计聚焦于分体式枪机头水平双前突笋闭锁，结实耐极寒冻油，徒手即可无工具完全拆解，奠定了其在狙击步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 莫辛-纳甘 M91/30 PU 栓动狙击步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「旋转后拉式栓动 · 双前水平闭锁突笋 + 防双供弹阻铁弹仓」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，射手手动旋转枪机手柄使刚性闭锁突笋脱槽，向后抽抛并推进新弹入膛，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托精加工而成。纳甘式内置单排 5 发弹仓配弹簧阻铁，精准隔离凸缘底缘杜绝双弹咬合，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。莫辛-纳甘 M91/30 PU 栓动狙击步枪 采用旋转后拉式栓动 · 双前水平闭锁突笋 + 防双供弹阻铁弹仓。在每个击发周期中，射手手动旋转枪机手柄使刚性闭锁突笋脱槽，向后抽抛并推进新弹入膛。借助发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托工艺与高强度配合，实现了纳甘式内置单排 5 发弹仓配弹簧阻铁，精准隔离凸缘底缘杜绝双弹咬合。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 7.62×54mmR 弹药规格与 730 mm 精选狙击级枪管 · 4 条右旋膛线（1:240 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 390 MPa，可赋予弹头 865 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,600 J 动能，有效作用距离达 800 米。
内膛技术特点方面，730 mm 超长精选狙击枪管充分释放 7.62×54mmR 发射药能量，初速达 865 m/s。同时，3.5×21 PU 钢镜紧凑坚固、零位稳固，高镜座保留下方机械照门紧急瞄准通道，令其在 15 发/分（手动下弯拉机柄） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 730 毫米身管与 7.62×54mmR 口径，莫辛-纳甘 M91/30 PU 栓动狙击步枪 实现了每秒 865 米的初速与 800 米有效射程。730 mm 超长精选狙击枪管充分释放 7.62×54mmR 发射药能量，初速达 865 m/s，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 5 发容量的机匣内置固定盒式弹仓与 36 mm 膛轴设计，莫辛-纳甘 M91/30 PU 栓动狙击步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 11.6 N·s 水平。730 mm 长枪管赋予 7.62×54mmR 弹头 865 m/s 平直弹道与 3,600 J 强劲动能。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-67）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 5 发容量的机匣内置固定盒式弹仓与出色的整体工效，730 mm 长枪管赋予 7.62×54mmR 弹头 865 m/s 平直弹道与 3,600 J 强劲动能。欢迎在 BAY-67 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 莫辛-纳甘 M91/30 PU 栓动狙击步枪 的机械魅力。

en.deck: Selected from the tightest-grouping barrels on the assembly line and fitted with a bent bolt handle and rugged 3.5× PU side-mount optic, the Mosin-Nagant M91/30 PU used an interrupter-controlled magazine to prevent rimlock in sub-zero Eastern Front combat. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-67.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Mosin M91/30 PU
paragraphs: Introduced in 1891 by Tula & Izhevsk Arsenals in Russia / USSR, the Mosin-Nagant M91/30 PU emerged as a defining Classic Bolt-Action Sniper Rifle. Over 37 million Mosin-Nagant rifles were built after 1891; M91/30 sniper variants became world-famous in WWII hands such as Vasily Zaitsev and Lyudmila Pavlichenko.

Selected from the tightest-grouping barrels on the assembly line and fitted with a bent bolt handle and rugged 3.5× PU side-mount optic, the Mosin-Nagant M91/30 PU used an interrupter-controlled magazine to prevent rimlock in sub-zero Eastern Front combat. Measuring 1,232 mm (Full-Length Birch Stock) at an unloaded weight of 4.27 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Sniper Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1891, Tula & Izhevsk Arsenals of Russia / USSR introduced the Mosin-Nagant M91/30 PU. Over 37 million Mosin-Nagant rifles were built after 1891; M91/30 sniper variants became world-famous in WWII hands such as Vasily Zaitsev and Lyudmila Pavlichenko. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Two-piece bolt with separate locking head strips without tools and resists arctic freeze-up — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Mosin-Nagant M91/30 PU sits its Turn-Bolt Action · Dual Horizontal Front Locking Lugs & Interrupter-Controlled Fixed Magazine. Throughout every firing cycle, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering, containing 390 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Interrupter-fed 5-round internal magazine eliminates rimlock with rimmed 7.62×54mmR cartridges, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Mosin-Nagant M91/30 PU relies on Turn-Bolt Action · Dual Horizontal Front Locking Lugs & Interrupter-Controlled Fixed Magazine. During each cycle, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering. Machined from blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Interrupter-fed 5-round internal magazine eliminates rimlock with rimmed 7.62×54mmR cartridges.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 7.62×54mmR with 730 mm Select Sniper Barrel · 4-Groove RH Rifling (1:240 mm Twist), the Mosin-Nagant M91/30 PU develops 865 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,600 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 800 meters.

Internally, 730 mm select-grade sniper barrel fully burns 7.62×54mmR propellant to reach 865 m/s muzzle velocity. Combined with its 15 RPM (Manual Turned-Down Bolt) tempo, Compact steel-tube 3.5× PU side-mount optic preserves iron-sight backup underneath, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 7.62×54mmR through its 730 millimeter bore, the Mosin-Nagant M91/30 PU achieves 865 meters per second and 800 meters of effective reach. 730 mm select-grade sniper barrel fully burns 7.62×54mmR propellant to reach 865 m/s muzzle velocity.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 5-round internal fixed box magazine with a 36 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 11.6 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. 730 mm barrel drives 7.62×54mmR rounds to 865 m/s and 3,600 J for 800 m engagements.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-67), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.

Pairing its 5-round internal fixed box magazine with disciplined recoil geometry, 730 mm barrel drives 7.62×54mmR rounds to 865 m/s and 3,600 J for 800 m engagements. Explore BAY-67 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the Mosin-Nagant M91/30 PU.
